newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken files for $250 debentures.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken files for $250 debentures.

text.p: Boston Chicken Inc Friday filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million in convertible subordinated debentures due 2004.

The company has granted the underwriters an overallotment option to purchase up to $37.5 million additional debentures. The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for development of the Boston Market system, including partial refinancing for certain of its area developers and Boston Market.

Proceeds will also be used for general corporate purposesf and repayment of borrowings under the company's revolving credit facility and to fund obligations under its convertible loan to Progressive Food Concepts Inc.
Boston Chicken, based in Golden, Colo., franchises and operates retail food service stores under the Boston Market brand name.
